iti75:1.1: vuttaṃ hetaṃ bhagavatā. vuttamarahatā’ti me sutaṃ:
iti75:2.1: tayo’me bhikkhave puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ.
iti75:3.2: idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo sabbesaññeva na dātā hoti, samaṇabrāhmaṇakapaṇaddhika vaṇibbaka yācakānaṃ annaṃ pānaṃ vatthaṃ yānaṃ mālāgandhavilepanaṃ seyyāvasatha padīpeyyaṃ.
iti75:3.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo avuṭṭhikasamo hoti.
iti75:4.2: idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo ekaccānaṃ dātā hoti, ekaccānaṃ na dātā hoti samaṇabrāhmaṇakapaṇaddhika vaṇibbaka yācakānaṃ annaṃ pānaṃ vatthaṃ yānaṃ mālāgandhavilepanaṃ seyyāvasatha padīpeyyaṃ.
iti75:4.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo padesavassī hoti.
iti75:5.2: idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo sabbesañca deti samaṇabrāhmaṇa kapaṇaddhikavaṇibbaka yācakānaṃ annaṃ pānaṃ vatthaṃ yānaṃ mālāgandhavilepanaṃ seyyāvasatha padīpeyyaṃ.
iti75:5.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo sabbatthābhivassī hoti.
iti75:5.4: ime kho bhikkhave tayo puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasminti.
iti75:11.1: ayampi attho vutto bhagavatā, iti me sutanti.
